report:
Fresh final marker followup of meta.reviews.claim_text. Preserved previous input/output, started fresh, read the complete claim and three ordinary test bodies, and recaptured every prior dependency: book/spec/review fixtures, parser prose extraction and book escaping. Compared all fragments by path/selector and both association metadata sets. Only an implementation_references association comment in spec.rs changed. All claim, behavior, tests, helpers and metadata are unchanged; no fragments were removed. This unrelated marker was reassessed against the complete prior findings below.

All four ordinary implementation entries are accounted for. spec.rs parse_anchors finalizes at real next-definition/heading/explicit-end/source-end boundaries; finish_anchor takes the whole selected source slice and trims only surrounding whitespace while retaining original spans. Sage load_workspace dedents each prose block first using common indentation among nonblank lines and retains an offset map. Relative indentation, internal newlines, Unicode and Markdown remain. Captured Parser::prose supplies the triple-quoted interior and original extent. review.rs inventory passes anchor.content through newline splitting into Claim fragments; claim selection re-resolves the same canonical content, without positional identity. AnchorPages::claim passes that same content to browser.rs render_spec_markdown for both page and disclosure views. Rendering supports rich Markdown, page-relative links and literal code, protects roles and escapes raw HTML. Outer newline encoding keeps generated raw-HTML wrappers intact through the subsequent Markdown stage. Saved source Markdown and rendered claim meaning are corresponding representations, not identical HTML strings.

complete_claim_blocks_are_selected_but_unrelated_movement_is_not_stale asserts exact captured Markdown containing later paragraph/list/table/fenced code, permits unrelated preceding/outside movement, then independently changes each later content category and requires stale validation. sage_prose_rules_have_precise_spans_model_owners_and_cross_source_references asserts exact normalized Sage text and identical review claim including Unicode, paragraphs/list/code and retained relative indentation, plus original source slices and separate member/method claims. anchor_pages_and_disclosures_render_the_complete_reviewed_content asserts exact source claim, runs actual preprocessing and checks both page definition and disclosure for bold/code, second paragraph, relative link, list, table and complete fenced example with its blank line. Both exclude the end marker/outside commentary while original context retains commentary. Their content is equal after only href normalization; a subsequent Markdown pass preserves the protected HTML and does not leak the example into prose/code events. Fixture helpers use actual inputs and production review/preprocessing paths; these assertions are visible in the tests.

Together these tests substantiate complete extent capture, surrounding-only trimming, Sage dedenting with internal preservation, later-content freshness and generated-view correspondence. No TODO/N/A entries exist. The marker-only change alters none of these conclusions. No source edits, formatting, tests or workspace build were performed; executed review start/read, capture comparisons and record only. No requested edits.
